  path={"/management/fleets/teams/{team_id}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



FindByTeam handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve fleet records associated with a specific team.
It expects the team ID as a URL parameter, validates it, and returns a paginated list of fleets
belonging to that team. Returns appropriate HTTP status codes and error messages for invalid
team IDs or if no fleets are found.
